title: Sources: Ravens to acquire Crosby in blockbuster

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: Ravens to acquire Crosby in blockbuster
sources.description: The Ravens have won the Maxx Crosby sweepstakes, beating out the Cowboys and others by sending 2026 and 2027 first-round picks to the Raiders for the star pass rusher, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.
